stage: Implementation details fixed before training or validation score inspection
schema_correction: First run produced no training rows because historical quotes use yes_bid.close/yes_ask.close fixed-dollar strings, while the live/batch endpoint uses close_dollars. Official historical endpoint documentation and raw acquired responses agree. A separate adapter corrects field names before the unchanged quote gates; no fit or validation score had been computed. Original failure retained.
training_label_gate: Recorded settlement_ts must be strictly before fitting; later or missing timestamps excluded and counted
revision_caveat: A recorded settlement time does not prove the retrieved outcome and metadata were unchanged since then
calibration_scope: Separate intercept and slope per predefined horizon, pooled across all training cities; no city selection
objective: Day-balanced weighted sum of binary log loss + 0.5 * lambda * slope^2, lambda=1 from original protocol; intercept unpenalized
weights: Equal calendar-day weight, equal event weight within day, equal eligible-contract weight within event
solver: L-BFGS-B, analytic gradient, starting intercept=0 slope=1, maxiter=1000 ftol=1e-12 gtol=1e-8; no parameter search
validation_gate: No probability score until complete development acquisition accounting; no decision before fixed fit cutoff; exact candle-end match; open_time <= decision < close_time
primary_probability_comparison: Logistic versus raw midpoint Brier difference, four horizons; daily equal-weight means
bootstrap: Paired circular blocks of consecutive calendar days, lengths 1/7/14, 10000 resamples, seed 20260906; endpoints wrap, approximate stationary-block inference
multiplicity: Approximate one-sided bootstrap p-values adjusted with Holm across the four predefined horizons separately per block length; development evidence only
coherence: Per-contract logistic and raw midpoint baselines need not sum to one across brackets. Measure this explicitly; neither is yet a production coherent bracket-distribution model.
holdout: Sealed October–December 2025 never enters fitting or scoring; no holdout release in this stage
execution: No fees, fills, P&L or capital-growth inference from these retrospective probability scores
